title: JSAbacusFramework.io
description: Sum all numbers in a nested JSON document, with optional red-object filtering.
writeup:
## Approach

Parse the input as JSON and recursively walk the tree, summing all integer values. Python's `json` module handles the parsing; the rest is a simple recursive traversal.

## Part 1

Sum every number in the document regardless of context. The recursion handles nested arrays and objects transparently.

## Part 2

Same traversal, but skip any object (dict) that contains `"red"` as a value. Arrays containing `"red"` are *not* skipped — only objects. A single boolean flag tracks whether we're inside a red object to exclude its numbers from the total.
